$comment: Round 32 lane I1 ledger fragment (instrument measurement, not a sweep). Merge into liber-primus/LEDGER.json.

entries.hypothesis: An explicit-advance beam decoder (advance in {1,2,free}) recovers planted skip_by_two, keyskip1 and free-drift ciphertext at L=120/400 and is adjudicated above a seed-3301 shuffle null; measures what R19/I1 did not (L=120, non-English registers, panel, null).
entries.verdict: INSTRUMENT-ENVELOPE-MEASURED; kill rule did not fire
entries.coverage: 3 enciphers x 3 advance decoders x L in {120,400} x 20 EN plants; L=6000 x 3 plants spot check; LATIN/OE/DE/EN_NOVOWEL x 5 enc/dec pairs x L{120,400} x 8-10 plants; shuffle null n=100 (n=4 at 6000); bounded re-adjudication of ONE seed (CICADA3301, sha256_ctr) on LP2 page-0 head, advance=2, offsets 0..3301, both signs, 0 flagged (best pmax 4.54 vs flag 10.0), control found true offset.
not_covered: I2 nine-register panel (EN_KJV, CY/Welsh) - corpora absent, 7-register lite panel used
vowel-dropped English under skip_by_two: advance=2 recovery 0.72/0.71 < 0.85 (failed control, register-side hole in the English-quadgram beam)
free drift q=0.05 at L=6000: recovery 0.611
advance relations other than 1,2,free; resets; rewrite/keyside/plainside
B-04 seeds other than CICADA3301 (about 2164 of 2165), other generators/pages, key families KDF/PRNG/Py2.7-MT
I3 contract bars (lite panel z scale differs); bars here are empirical shuffle-null maxima
entries.positive_control: passed (EN/LATIN/OE/DE matched recovery >=0.99 at L=120/400; replication of L7-B 0.30 vs 0.258); EN_NOVOWEL FAILED (0.72/0.71)
entries.threshold: RECOVERED iff median rune-index recovery >= 0.85 and >=80% seeds pmax above shuffle-null max (PREREG s3, fixed before running); re-adjudication flag pmax>10 (Addendum A).
entries.overlap: round19/I1/driftbeam.py already implements the three relations; beam_v2.py is a facade over it. Lane value = L=120 / register / panel / null measurement.
entries.reopens_if: a panel-aware or language-agnostic beam score is built (fixes EN_NOVOWEL); Welsh/KJV/Mabinogion corpora restored and the I2 panel rebuilt (re-run run_envelope.py against it); a different B-04 seed/page is re-adjudicated.
